## What's New in v0.4.1

### Bug Fixes & Stability

- **Tighter launch readiness** — Fixed render-loop instability on the Home and Context pages by stabilizing array references and moving inline `.filter()` calls into memoized values. Pages no longer risk unnecessary re-renders when query data hasn't actually changed. (#123)
- **Improved test isolation** — Extracted the shared `with_loadout_home` test helper into a dedicated `test_utils` module, with proper panic unwinding so environment variables are always restored even when assertions fail. (#123)
- **Cleaner lint baseline** — Removed suppressed ESLint comments (`eslint-disable-next-line`) by switching `useInfiniteList` from `useState` to `useReducer`, eliminating the root cause instead of silencing the warning. (#123)
